ValidationRule.description: Prevents event status from advancing past Inquiry status until all proposal sent validation requirements are cleared.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( TEXT(Status__c) = "Proposal Sent", TEXT(Status__c) = "Confirmed", TEXT(Status__c) = "In Planning", TEXT(Status__c) = "Executing", TEXT(Status__c) = "Completed" ), OR( ISBLANK(Expected_Headcount__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Event_Type__c)), ISBLANK(Event_Start_Date__c), ISBLANK(Quoted_Price__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Event status cannot move past Inquiry until the following fields are populated: Expected Headcount, Event Type, Event Start Date, and Quoted Price.
